faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions

items.question: Q. What is InnoLive?
items.answer: InnoLive is a broadcast tool that de-identifies other people's faces in real time during a live stream. Register people who are allowed to appear, and everyone else is covered automatically.

items.question: Q. The app does not work on my device.
items.answer: InnoLive requires iOS 26 or later and Android 11 or later for stable operation.

items.question: Q. Which streaming platforms can I use?
items.answer: InnoLive currently supports YouTube and CHZZK.

items.question: Q. My face is covered on the stream.
items.answer: To appear on the broadcast, register your own face as an allowed person first. If you already did, make sure your face is clearly visible to the camera.

items.question: Q. Can I register more than one face?
items.answer: Yes. You can register each co-host as an allowed person. Free allows up to 2 faces, and Streamer and above allow up to 5.
